categories.main_business_segments: SEP Analytical (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. primarily operates in third-party testing and technical services, focusing on environmental soil and groundwater testing, water and gas testing, food safety testing, drilling sampling, remediation services, and technical consulting. The company also provides agricultural environmental protection services, occupational health testing, and integrates ESG sustainable solutions. It serves government agencies, consulting firms, engineering companies, and end customers across multiple sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced analytical technologies including liquid chromatography, gas chromatography-mass spectrometry, and inductively coupled plasma optical emission spectrometry. It develops non-standard testing methods for emerging pollutants and soil contaminants, participates in national standard setting, and integrates digital platforms for data analysis and intelligent monitoring. The company also invests in robotic inspection technologies and AI integration for enhanced service delivery.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government departments, consulting agencies, engineering firms, research institutes, and leading enterprises in soil and groundwater remediation. The company serves industries such as environmental protection, agriculture, food safety, steel, chemical, energy, and power sectors. It also caters to downstream clients requiring environmental monitoring, product quality testing, and occupational health services.
categories.geographic_coverage: Headquartered in Shanghai, SEP Analytical has established laboratories and offices across major regions in China including Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Anhui, Beijing, Tianjin, Hebei, Shandong, Guangdong, Jiangxi, Sichuan, and others. Its service network covers 31 provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions nationwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as a midstream third-party testing and technical service provider within the environmental and product quality assurance supply chain. It offers sampling, testing, diagnosis, remediation, and consulting services, acting as an independent verifier and solution provider between raw material producers, manufacturers, and end users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: SEP Analytical focuses on enhancing R&D capabilities in soil and groundwater testing, emerging pollutant detection, and remediation technologies. It pursues digital transformation through intelligent data platforms, AI, and robotics integration. The company aims to expand testing scope into marine, radiation, metrology, and consumer goods sectors, while strengthening brand reputation and sustainable development solutions aligned with national environmental policies.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue mainly through fees charged for testing services, technical consulting, sampling, and remediation projects. It operates on a direct sales model supported by a nationwide laboratory network, providing standardized, efficient, and professional services. Revenue is recognized upon completion and client acceptance of testing or consulting deliverables.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: SEP Analytical is positioned as a leading specialized third-party testing institution in soil and groundwater within China, recognized for its technical expertise and comprehensive service capabilities. It competes with numerous domestic testing firms in an industry characterized by fragmentation and increasing consolidation. The company leverages its certifications, extensive project experience, and strategic acquisitions to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 442 million, representing an 18.26% increase over the previous year. Despite a net loss of RMB 65.79 million, the company improved cash flow from operations and narrowed losses compared to prior years. Total assets stood at RMB 1.13 billion with a net asset value of RMB 720.78 million. The company continues to invest in R&D and expand its service capabilities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SEP Analytical emphasizes its comprehensive, one-stop testing and technical service platform with strong capabilities in soil and groundwater analysis, emerging pollutant detection, and environmental remediation. It differentiates through rigorous quality control, extensive accreditations (CMA, CNAS, CATL), rapid response to client needs, and integration of digital and robotic technologies. The company’s deep industry experience and government project involvement enhance its credibility and customer trust.
